annotations.title: Save boundary file to the library

description: Exports a boundary (like export_boundary) and saves it in the organization's file library, so teammates find it on the dashboard and through list_files. visibility org (default) shares it with every member at their role; restricted keeps it to you, admins and whoever you share it with (share_file). Saving the same boundary, format and detail again returns the existing entry. Costs 1 unit. Returns the library entry with its permanent download url. Needs an API key or a connected account.

boundary_id.description: Boundary id, as get_boundary accepts it (r62422, wikidata:Q64, iso:US-CA…).

name.description: A label for the library; default: the boundary's name, format and detail.
